question: What does this Data Mapper read and write, and is it the same across orgs?

steps.name: mapper
steps.soql: SELECT Id, Name, Type, VersionNumber, IsActive, InputType, OutputType, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM OmniDataTransform WHERE Name = '{name}'

steps.name: items
steps.soql: SELECT InputObjectName, InputFieldName, OutputObjectName, OutputFieldName, FilterOperator, FilterValue, FormulaExpression, IsDisabled FROM OmniDataTransformItem WHERE OmniDataTransformationId IN ({@mapper.Id}) ORDER BY OutputObjectName, OutputFieldName

traps: In an extract filter, an unquoted $Vlocity.NULL on "=" silently skips the whole query. Quote it.
